slidePlayer.note: Slides from the launch film need slide-engine changes made after v0.2.0 (Become pairs morph outline to outline; transforms repaint their complete end state; dissolve is the default transform method). The website's slide player is built from this public revision plus the listed patches.

patches.fixes: FLUX-057: an exported Become into a set of shapes and a caption bakes the caption's letter outlines, so letters fly as in Present.
